selected_memories.text: Official rule: activating NIX-51 converts GOL-82 into its active form.
When active GOL-82 is present, it produces XAN-38.
Official revision: for the chain involving XAN-38 and CYN-24, the accepted terminal code is PEL-31; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with CYN-24 is KEL-76.
When XAN-38 encounters CYN-24, the validated terminal code becomes PEL-31.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with NIX-80 is ZUM-21.
Official revision: for the chain involving ZUM-28 and NIX-80, the accepted terminal code is SIV-55; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active BIR-20 is present, it produces ZUM-28.
Official rule: activating XAN-67 converts BIR-20 into its active form.
When ZUM-28 encounters NIX-80, the validated terminal code becomes SIV-55.
Official revision: for the chain involving FAR-74 and NIX-64, the accepted terminal code is FEN-53; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active FAR-27 is present, it produces FAR-74.
Official rule: activating TEK-14 converts FAR-27 into its active form.
When FAR-74 encounters NIX-64, the validated terminal code becomes FEN-53.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with NIX-64 is LOQ-22.
